challenges.name: Jobs
challenges.description: A secret word from the world of jobs and professions
challenges.howto: 👥 Imposter game: everyone will know a secret word from the chosen category, except one person: the Imposter (who only knows the category). Pass the device around and have each player secretly reveal their role and then hide it. Then discuss for 5 minutes: each player asks questions or drops hints about the word without saying it outright. The Imposter must blend in, and everyone else must figure them out. At the end, vote on who the Imposter is.
